# 8Bit Music Code Studio

> A chiptune studio in one Python file (NumPy synth, Tk GUI). The `8bms` CLI, MCP server, ACP agent, HTTP API and Python module all share one op registry: compose, variation, extend, arrange, remix, loopify, humanize, soundpack, stems, master, describe, critique, diff, suggest, intent, render, export. Ops are deterministic for a seed, return one terse line (or `--json`), take `--fields` to trim output, and pass songs as handles (`@last`). Offline; MIT.

Start here: run `8bms tools` (or `--json`), then `8bms <op> --help`. Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RechargedIdeas/8bit-music-code-studio/main/install.sh | sh` (Windows: `irm …/install.ps1 | iex`).

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): output contract, repo map, op table, recipes, .8bt cheat-sheet
- [Agent framework](docs/agent-framework.md): ops, handles, fields, batch, intent, library
- [CLI reference](docs/cli-reference.md): every command and op with args (generated)
- [Score format](docs/score-format.md): `.8bt` text scores
- [Note language](docs/note-language.md): `o5 l8 c e g >c`, chords, repeats, ties
- [MCP](docs/mcp.md), [ACP](docs/acp.md), [HTTP API](docs/http-api.md), [Python API](docs/python-api.md)
- [Exporting](docs/exporting.md): WAV/OGG, seamless loops, stems, JS/Python/JSON code
- [MIDI/APC](docs/midi-apc.md), [Testing with real APC hardware](docs/apc-hardware-testing.md): `8bms apc test`
- [ML](docs/ml.md): the 43 KB offline model; implemented vs design-only
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md), [FAQ](docs/faq.md), [Glossary](docs/glossary.md), [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
